claim_one_line: THE TWO INGREDIENTS, REPLICATED (P-293; sealed 8024632e1, sha256 f7f1c28c; PROVED as sealed for its question -- R1-R5 hold, R6 and R7 fail as expected, the control C1 holds; outputs committed unread at f1b7eb522): on 23 940 points nobody had computed, with the menus fixed in advance and the covariant readings only, the six charged-fermion ratios come within 1.202 (tau = 0.55 + 3.05i, the order-10 line (2/5, 1/2), L_max, up S~ with down and leptons S, c = 3) and are specific under the seat's menu (0.12% of random hierarchies as good, every seed below 0.3%), under every covariant reading assignment (0.41%) and, at the bar, with c free (0.92%, 5 of 20 seeds above 1%); the nine (with |V_us|, |V_cb|, |V_ub|) are specific under the seat's menu (0.58%, best 1.90 at 0.55 + 2.55i on (2/5, 1/10), S~ throughout) but not under the covariant menu (1.66%); |J| at the best nine-row is 7.8 times too small and P-094's double ratio at the best six-row is 11.01 (3.9 sigma). After the read (labelled): the good rows form a band over every Re tau at Im tau 2.55-3.25, only on lines of order 5 and 10, where the frame sees SU(5)'s five-ality (B1728) and the factor 3 breaks Y_e = Y_d^T as Georgi-Jarlskog's 45 does; on order-5 lines D = 9 exactly; without the factor the six are not specific (2.28, 24%); after Bonferroni over the four specificity looks only the six under the seat's menu pass THE_BAR's gate (0.0048). Graded a READING (two hand-put ingredients, the reading rule P-295 and the factor P-294 to derive); a third opinion from the seats is asked. 0 of 19.
